prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Karthik ji, Pooja S., Pooja ji, Kavita ji.
The chat covers 14/03/26, 8:15 pm to 14/03/26, 10:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja ji: Kavita ji, delete the transfer record right now
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:12 at 9:15 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:25 differs by 10 min (tolerance 2)
text:
14/03/26, 8:15 pm - Karthik ji: Hello everyone, did we finalize the vendor payment list for this week?
14/03/26, 8:20 pm - Pooja S.: Yes Karthik ji, I sent the sheet on email earlier today.
14/03/26, 8:28 pm - Kavita ji: I reviewed the sheet, everything looks fine from my side.
14/03/26, 8:35 pm - Pooja ji: Please check the new UPI transfer request from the new supplier.
14/03/26, 8:42 pm - Karthik ji: Is the account verification complete for that supplier?
14/03/26, 8:50 pm - Pooja S.: I will double check the GST details tomorrow morning.
14/03/26, 8:58 pm - Kavita ji: Should I hold the batch processing until then?
14/03/26, 9:05 pm - Pooja ji: No need to wait, process the small amounts first.
14/03/26, 9:10 pm - Karthik ji: Okay, but keep track of all transaction reference numbers.
14/03/26, 9:15 pm - Pooja S.: Noted, saving all receipts in the shared folder.
14/03/26, 9:20 pm - Kavita ji: I just initiated the transfer for the pending invoices.
14/03/26, 9:25 pm - Karthik ji: Wait, I see an unverified UPI ID in the log, let me call you.
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja ji: Kavita ji, delete the transfer record right now
14/03/26, 9:30 pm - Kavita ji: Why? Is there an issue with the recipient details?
14/03/26, 9:35 pm - Pooja S.: I am looking at the dashboard now, which record are you talking about?
14/03/26, 9:42 pm - Karthik ji: Do not delete anything until we verify the audit trail.
14/03/26, 9:48 pm - Kavita ji: Understood, I haven't cleared any logs.
14/03/26, 9:55 pm - Pooja ji: I will check with the finance team tomorrow morning.
14/03/26, 10:00 pm - Pooja S.: Let's freeze all pending transfers for tonight.
14/03/26, 10:05 pm - Karthik ji: Agreed, we will discuss this in the morning meeting.
14/03/26, 10:10 pm - Kavita ji: Okay, closing the portal for today.
14/03/26, 10:15 pm - Pooja S.: Goodnight everyone.
